An anchor split around a block keeps the half that carries its text

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<a href="/o">Text<div><a href="/i">Inner</a></div></a>')
puts result.content.inspect
```
